name: record
description: A content record shown on the canvas as the record it is: the note on the notes page and the note on the canvas are one thing, edited in either place. Give it the type and the record's id; the server fills in the words from the record when it renders the page.

use.when: a note, task or event belongs on the canvas as itself, edited in either place.
use.not: copying a record's words into a card.

type.description: The content type, such as note.

record.description: The record's id, from find_records or a page URL /t/<type>/<id>.

detail.title: How much to show
detail.description: brief is the title alone, for a pane or a list of many. full is the title, the text and the other fields. page adds the way to the record's own page. Expanding a block asks for page.

level.title: Heading level
level.description: Heading level of the title so the block fits the page outline.

title.description: Filled in by the server from the record. Leave out.

titleProp.description: Filled in by the server: the field the title comes from. Leave out.

text.description: Filled in by the server: the record's main text. Leave out.

textProp.description: Filled in by the server: the field the text comes from. Leave out.

fields.description: Filled in by the server: the record's other fields with something in them. Leave out.

structured.description: Filled in by the server when the text is structured (Markdown): it is shown with its headings under the title and edited as it is shown. Leave out.

missing.description: Filled in by the server when the record no longer exists. Leave out.

keyboard.does: reaches the link to the record's own page at page detail; the text is edited in place through the block's own Edit control

wcag.notes: The title is a real heading at the level the page outline needs (1.3.1). The other fields are a definition list, so each value is announced with its name. A record that no longer exists says so in words rather than rendering nothing (3.3.1). Editing reuses the inline editor, whose controls are native and labelled.

machine.identify: Read data-record-type and data-record-id for which record this is, and data-detail for the size shown. The heading is the record's title; each dd in the definition list is one field, named by its dt.
machine.operate: Change the record through the block's Edit control, which posts to /t/<type>/<id>/props, or through the API at /api/<type>/<id>. At page detail the link opens the record's own page.
